mintAuthority.summary: BRLV's canonical native issuance is on Base. Crown's issuer relay, the Base token DEFAULT_ADMIN and UPGRADE_ROLE paths, and the canonical-domain BRLVRewards branch remain in Mint Authority; Ethereum bridgedBRLV, the Base canonical gateway's cross-chain branch, and bridge-only role administrators are scored under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: Crown issuance backend
controls.evidence: Issuer-operated mint/redeem: Crown creates BRLV supply against segregated, bankruptcy-remote Brazilian Treasury bond reserves via KYC-gated primary issuance and redeems 1:1 for BRL; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.

controls.label: BRLV Base DEFAULT_ADMIN / UPGRADE_ROLE manager - EOA 0x239d4a
controls.evidence: At Base block 48678900, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x239d4a24efa36a8987b86184c080ace26b3a8968) returned true on 0xd2047ebdb205ee6862b69ae9fb3501652cc97d36 and eth_getCode returned 0x. getRoleAdmin(UPGRADE_ROLE) returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Verified token implementation source makes _authorizeUpgrade require UPGRADE_ROLE, so this zero-delay EOA can grant that role and authorize a token implementation change as well as manage minters.

controls.label: BRLV Base MINTER_ROLE — gasless relay EOA 0x8e7e9b
controls.evidence: At Base block 48679023, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x8e7e9b5f0a5fab0be8adc71dad483dff45d719ea) returned true. Its EIP-7702 designation code is 0xef01000000fb7702036ff9f76044a501ac1aa74cbab16b, so the signer remains an EOA account delegated to UniversalGaslessDelegate rather than an independently governed contract.

controls.label: BRLV Base MINTER_ROLE — BRLVRewards canonical-domain reward branch
controls.evidence: At Base block 48678900, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x5315c03f8cf027d1b67dac72ef9eec8988d80f88) returned true. Its ERC-1967 implementation slot resolved to verified BRLVRewards implementation 0x6818b4b2c3cc572726aed81a836b5e069519ad0a. The canonical-domain reward branch calls brlv.mintShares against gateway.availableSurplus(), so this role remains in Mint Authority for surplus-bounded canonical reward issuance; its remote-domain gateway.bridgedSharesMint branch is separately scored under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: BRLV Base active UPGRADE_ROLE - EOA 0xcdfc72
controls.evidence: At Base block 48678900, hasRole(UPGRADE_ROLE, 0xcdfc7264f7eda78c1e4368a5f291e6a16738cb5a) returned true and eth_getCode returned 0x. The zero-admin-slot proxy resolves to implementation 0x1750731729b27cfd00ea55bc61e9dcfade2273f3, whose verified _authorizeUpgrade requires UPGRADE_ROLE, giving this EOA an immediate Base token upgrade path.

controls.label: BRLVRewards active UPGRADE_ROLE - EOA 0x548634
controls.evidence: At Base block 48678900, hasRole(UPGRADE_ROLE, 0x548634f237eae194f5e20982c9819d917fe17f04) returned true and eth_getCode returned 0x. The zero-admin-slot rewards proxy resolves to implementation 0x6818b4b2c3cc572726aed81a836b5e069519ad0a, whose verified _authorizeUpgrade requires UPGRADE_ROLE, giving this EOA an immediate upgrade path over the canonical reward minter; any remote-domain bridgedSharesMint change is separately scored under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: BRLVRewards DEFAULT_ADMIN / UPGRADE_ROLE manager - EOA 0x7ecf4c
controls.evidence: At Base block 48678900, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x7ecf4c03e7115a66c86ac9745cf0a8b903e3411f) returned true and eth_getCode returned 0x. getRoleAdmin(UPGRADE_ROLE) returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE; therefore this zero-delay EOA can grant or revoke the rewards implementation's UPGRADE_ROLE, independently of the current 0x548634 holder. Its remote-domain upgrade surface is separately scored under Bridge Risk.

review.evidence: At Base block 50068610, the canonical BRLV proxy resolves through a zero EIP-1967 admin slot to verified implementation 0x1750731729b27cfd00ea55bc61e9dcfade2273f3; the shared DEFAULT_ADMIN EOA 0x239d4a can manage Base minters and grant UPGRADE_ROLE, while active Base UPGRADE_ROLE EOA 0xcdfc72 provides an immediate token upgrade path. Base's issuer relay directly mints, and BRLVRewards retains its canonical-domain surplus-bounded reward branch; the rewards proxy has active and role-admin upgrade EOAs with zero delay. Ethereum bridgedBRLV, the Base canonical gateway's remote mint/burn machinery, and their bridge administrators are retained as structured Bridge Risk controls rather than compiled into canonical Mint Authority. Crown backs BRLV with segregated Brazilian federal Treasury bonds and Tesouro Selic ETFs; Fact Finance performs daily independent reserve verification with full liability reconciliation published on Crown's transparency page, so supply is continuously reconciled. Reserve custody sits at BCB-regulated banks, but that is custodial regulation, not issuer supervision: no BCB or CVM registry names Crown/BRLV as a licensed stablecoin issuer, so supervision is attestation-only and BRLV remains in the high tier.
